title: Message your other Claude Code sessions
summary: This documentation describes Claude Code's cross-session messaging feature, enabling users to send messages between different Claude Code sessions running in separate terminals or contexts, supporting multi-agent workflows and distributed AI collaboration.
problem_solved: Enables communication and coordination between multiple concurrent Claude Code sessions, solving the isolation problem in distributed AI-assisted development workflows.
why_valuable: This feature unlocks multi-agent architectures where different AI sessions can specialize in tasks (e.g., frontend, backend, testing) and collaborate by passing context and instructions between each other.
